context: CityCare Clinic wants an online appointment booking system. The student interviews the clinic operations coordinator to understand appointment scheduling, patient safety, privacy, reminders, and integrations with existing clinic systems.

requirements.text: Patients must be able to book appointments online.
requirements.reveal_condition: General question about online appointment booking.

requirements.text: The system must show available doctor time slots before confirming an appointment.
requirements.reveal_condition: Question about doctor availability or appointment time slots.

requirements.text: Urgent symptoms must trigger guidance to contact emergency services instead of booking a routine appointment.
requirements.reveal_condition: Question about urgent symptoms or emergency cases.

requirements.text: Patients can reschedule or cancel appointments up to 24 hours before the appointment time.
requirements.reveal_condition: Question about changing or canceling appointments.

requirements.text: The system should send appointment reminders by SMS or email.
requirements.reveal_condition: Question about reminders or reducing no-shows.

requirements.text: The system must integrate with the existing EHR to retrieve patient demographics.
requirements.reveal_condition: Question about patient data or existing clinical systems.

requirements.text: The system should support insurance eligibility checks before appointment confirmation.
requirements.reveal_condition: Question about insurance or eligibility before confirmation.

requirements.text: Doctors must be able to block unavailable time slots.
requirements.reveal_condition: Question about doctor calendars or unavailable periods.

requirements.text: Access to patient appointment data must be role-based.
requirements.reveal_condition: Question about privacy, roles, or patient data access.

requirements.text: Appointment changes must be auditable with timestamp and staff/user identity.
The system should support both Vietnamese and English patient-facing screens.
requirements.reveal_condition: Question about language support or patient diversity.

requirements.text: The system must support at least 200 concurrent booking requests during morning peak hours.
requirements.reveal_condition: Question about peak load or performance.
